title: Workspace lifecycle (active / once / later / archive)
description: Classify whether this git is actively worked, a finished one-shot, parked for later, or an archive candidate. Prefer CLI lifecycle.
goalTemplate:
Classify lifecycle for repositories {{repositories}}. Thresholds: active≤{{activeDays}}d, once≥{{onceDays}}d, archive≥{{archiveDays}}d.

1) Run `ncc ai workflow lifecycle --workspace <id> --json` (or `--all` for fleet).
2) Explain state: active | once | later | archive-candidate.
3) Recommend next templates (autonomous-agent-run, changelog-creator, workspace-archive-suggest, …).
4) Do not write files. Do not archive anything.
